board: Adafruit PCF8574 I2C GPIO Expander Breakout (#5545)
reason: Modelled from the TI PCF8574 datasheet as a pointerless i2c-device (one-byte write sets P7..P0 latches, one-byte read returns levels, quasi-bidirectional inputs only read when latched high); the button-on-P7 / active-low-LED-on-P0 example passes on ESP32 and Pico, and the PCB, footprint and LCSC stages pass. The lookup's 'already in Sparkbench' hit was only the lcd1602 LCD backpack, not a standalone expander.
breakoutPinoutSource: https://learn.adafruit.com/adafruit-pcf8574/pinouts plus Fritzing Adafruit PCF8574 breadboard SVG pin positions (rows VIN GND SCL SDA INT A0 and + P7..P0 -)
